K → coordinator/codexpc: W385331 qualification round 5 — the guard correction for M385402 is prepared, proved on fixtures with the REAL build stamp, and run once read-only on the real checkout; narrow delta for review. No product change; no build, install, image or live execution; no rebind; the 7ac02c7f binding stays selected.

THE INCONSISTENCY, AS RECORDED. `bind` writes three untracked records and `bundle` writes its evidence directory before packaging; `tools/build_stamp.py` observes the whole repository (`status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal`, excusing only its three build outputs), so a bundle built after `bind` is truthfully `dirty: true` with `v12/` clean, and the round-4 `assert dirty is False` guards in bundle and install could never pass. The stamp is right and is not argued with, falsified or chased with a commit.

THE CORRECTION (helper c77783eb…, was d2404e16…; new classifier config/native-handoffs-2-tree.py 13d237e6…; binder unchanged 4cc1469e…).
- tree.py takes the stamp's own observation and classifies EVERY dirty path: product (under v12/) → refuse; declared-input (under a declared consumed input of the test runner, from `tools.source_identity --declared`) → refuse; generated (an UNTRACKED entry at one of the exact record paths this qualification writes for the bound sha8: the three bind records, worker documents/compose logs, native-workers-2-<sha8>.json, evidence/checkpoint-<sha8>-packaging/, evidence/worker-image-<sha8>/, evidence/native-handoffs-2-qualification/create-*) → allowed; stale (a record path of ANOTHER checkpoint) → refuse, naming records the operator removes or commits; unclassified → refuse. Full inventory recorded (status, path, class, identity content digest, consumed-file count).
- check(): adds the content-bound source identity of the bound checkout (`changed` must be empty; declared inputs present; document written outside the tree) and the inventory, after the existing v12-clean / HEAD / bind --check guards.
- bundle: inventory before the build (tree-state.before.json) and after it beside the stamp (tree-state.after.json, build-stamp.json); the stamp must name SHA and its dirty/changed_entries must EQUAL the inventory, every entry generated. dirty:false over existing records, a count the inventory does not show, or another commit → refuse.
- install: the instance's identity.build_stamp must be the SAME document the bundle step recorded (same commit, same truthful dirty count), not dirty:false.
- Source-identity policy applied unchanged; no spec weakened: a dirty product input still refuses before anything runs. QUALIFY_DECLARED defaults to --declared (fixtures without the declared inputs pass empty).

PROOF (checks/test_qualify.py 795365c3…, 24 checks, run 9 OK d7c0abc4…; 18 prior checks carried). Deterministic REAL-stamp proof: on the fixture after bind, `tools.build_stamp.capture` yields dirty:true changed_entries:4 excused:0 (three bind records + the evidence directory), both inventories show exactly those as generated, and bundle PASSES with that stamp. Refusals: stamp claiming dirty:false over the records ("untruthful stamp … inventory shows 4 entries"); stamp naming another commit; untracked product file (v12 guard); unclassified untracked path outside v12 before any command (zero stub calls); a previous binding's record named stale; install with a stamp differing from the recorded one. Positive: check passes with exactly the three records; install accepts the recorded stamp. The round-4 hand-written clean-stamp tests are replaced by these (the clean-stamp expectation was the defect).

REAL CHECKOUT, read-only, once (checks/logs/host-check-7ac02c7f-prereview.log f6afa46e…; host-source-identity-7ac02c7f.json 08c1c035…): at HEAD 7ac02c7f the binding verified 43 paths; the identity with --declared succeeded (changed [], 41 consumed files, digest 5665f3d6…); the coordinator's three bind records classified generated; and check REFUSED on five unclassified entries — this round's own uncommitted delta (qualify.sh, test_qualify.py, tree.py, two history snapshots). CONSEQUENCE FOR THE OWNER (recorded in PACKET §3). Committing this correction moves HEAD; check then refuses "HEAD is not the bound checkpoint 7ac02c7f" until the binding is redone against the new checkpoint: remove (or commit as history) the three 7ac02c7f records — bind refuses to overwrite a binding and the classifier names them stale — then `bind` again, proving the same 43 joined paths at the new HEAD (no v12 path changes in this round). messages.author: prompt
messages.body:
K → coordinator/codexpc: W385331 qualification round 6 — G1–G3 corrected on the CURRENT checkpoint 7ac02c7f with no commit, rebind, build, install or live action; the finite sequence is demonstrated from `check` on the real checkout; narrow immutable delta for review. Product untouched (v12/ clean at 7ac02c7f; composer fa01b73d…/bb5fa705… intact; binder unchanged 4cc1469e…).

G1 — WHAT IS BOUND, AND NOTHING ELSE GATES. The qualification's inputs are now exactly: (a) the selected source — the 43 joined paths at the bound commit (bind.py), v12/ clean, and the content-bound identity `tools.source_identity --declared v12` with `changed` empty; (b) the test runner's declared consumed inputs (20 paths / 41 files on 7ac02c7f), hashed by content with collapsed untracked directories expanded, refused if dirty in git; (c) the reviewed helper bytes — bind.py, tree.py, qualify.sh and the two unbound documents — pinned by `config/native-handoffs-2-reviewed.sha256` (a8337f0a…) and checked with `sha256sum -c` before anything relies on them. `check` records these once per checkpoint in `config/native-inputs-2-<sha8>.json` (content digest, declared inputs, consumed count, sums digest) and every later step compares; a difference refuses as input drift. Every other dirty path — review evidence, older qualification records, dossier notes, this qualification's own generated records — is INVENTORIED with its class (generated / helper / unrelated / build-output excused / product / declared-input) and is not a gate. No record is deleted; the round-5 "remove or commit stale records, then rebind" is withdrawn. No one-time helper checkpoint is required: the reviewed helper bytes are bound by content (the sums file the review binds), not by commit.

G2 — THE STAMP IS KEPT AS CAPTURED. It must name the bound commit and carry an observation (`dirty` not null); its dirty/changed_entries are never re-derived from a later inventory. The LIVE `tools.build_stamp.capture(source=checkout)` is taken at each step with actual semantics (excusals included) and recorded beside the inventory for comparison only, labelled as such. The stamp's relation to the selected source rests on the inputs record being identical before and after the gate.

G3 — THE ARTIFACT BEFORE ANY EFFECT. `install` requires the bundle step's recorded evidence (build-stamp.json, distro-sha256.txt, bundle-identity.json), hashes the bundle present now against the recorded distro SHA256, runs its `identity` and requires equality with the recorded identity (stamp included) — all before `just bootstrap`; missing evidence, other bytes under the same stamp, or another stamp refuse there with no bootstrap call. After bootstrap the installed identity.sha256 and build_stamp must equal the verified artifact's.

PROOF (checks/test_qualify.py 2c522544…, 24 checks, run 12 OK b96d453f…; runs 10–11 retained as the checks' own development — collapsed-directory name, call-list and gitignore expectations). Finite sequence: with unrelated review evidence, an older checkpoint's records, a dossier note, this qualification's records and the gate's own evidence all dirty, check → bundle → check pass on the SAME commit (HEAD asserted unchanged) and the REAL capture stamp (dirty:true, changed_entries 9 = everything the repository showed at capture time, excused 0) is recorded unchanged with the inputs record stable. Reviewer counterexamples covered on the round-6 bytes: unrelated review evidence does not gate; the capture's three excused build outputs are labelled as excused, never product (tool-boundary classification plus the real capture over the same observation: dirty true, changed 3, excused 3; in the checkout they are gitignored and never appear — a checkout that un-ignored them would hit the v12/ guard, the product-scope rule); a later allowed evidence write does not make the recorded stamp false; `install` refuses a different stamp and same-stamp/different-bytes BEFORE bootstrap (no bootstrap call, no instance.json) and installs the verified bundle once, then fails an installed identity that is not the artifact's. Also: changed helper byte refuses before anything; untracked file inside a declared input and an edited declared input refuse as drift; stamp naming another commit or with no observation refuses; the 17 prior binding/control-flow/create/compose/no-store checks carried.

REAL CHECKOUT, 7ac02c7f, no commit (checks/logs/host-check-7ac02c7f-r6.log 58a68263…): `check` PASSED — 43 paths verified; helper bytes equal the reviewed sums; identity with --declared: 41 consumed files, changed [], digest 5665f3d6…, recorded to config/native-inputs-2-7ac02c7f.json (0525ddb1…); live capture dirty:true changed_entries:30 excused:0; 31 dirty paths inventoried, none an input. Honest development note: an earlier check with a pre-final tree.py wrote the inputs record; the helper bytes then changed and the next check REFUSED as input drift (`['helper_sums_sha256'] differ`, checks/logs/host-check-7ac02c7f-r6-drift.log) — the stability check working; that record was renamed to config/native-inputs-2-7ac02c7f.superseded-r6-dev.json (kept, inventoried as unrelated), and the final check wrote the record against the reviewed sums. From here the sequence is bundle (K, on selection) → image (O) → install (O, verifies the exact bundle first) → compose (K) → repeat (O) → create (O) → start (O), none needing a commit; the owner's later commit of this correction is the ordinary milestone checkpoint, not a prerequisite. All commands in the packet that stand in a real step are labelled stand-ins in the checks; no real build/image/install/live command was run.

DELTA. tree.py adf11b40… (was 13d237e6…; rewritten: inventory + inputs stability, no unrelated gate); qualify.sh 160fae0d… (was c77783eb…; check adds reviewed-sums and inputs record; bundle keeps the stamp; install verifies before bootstrap); PACKET.md cdeb61e2… (was 18304068…). Reviewed round-5 bytes preserved byte-exact in history/ (PACKET-r5-reviewed-385406.md, qualify-r5-reviewed-385406.sh, tree-r5-reviewed-385406.py, from the reviewer's snapshots); deltas history/PACKET-r5-to-r6.diff (69377c46…, 69 lines), qualify-r5-to-r6.diff (c9dd223a…, 138), tree-r5-to-r6.diff (d8b1ac91…, 302). The sums file lists bind.py 4cc1469e…, tree.py adf11b40…, qualify.sh 160fae0d…, the unbound instance 795f4a06…, the unbound task 5c3ae5a1…; `sha256sum -c` passes on the checkout.
